sources.title: Monmouth County Summary Results Report - County Committee, Republican Primary Election June 2, 2026 (OFFICIAL RESULTS, generated 2026-06-12)
Monmouth County Election Office past election results page (says municipal clerks, not the County Clerk, certify county committee results; tie votes create vacancies)
Monmouth County Summary Results Report - County Committee - REP, June 4, 2024 Primary (shows the previous Republican county committee election two years earlier)
N.J.S.A. 19:5-3 (one committeeman and one committeewoman per election district)

notes: Official results of the June 2, 2026 primary: 485 'REP - County Committee <municipality> <district>' contests, each Vote For 2, reported as countywide contest totals (no district-level privacy suppression). Monmouth Republicans also elected the county committee in the June 4, 2024 primary, so the county elects every two years in even years. The report does not mark which candidate is running for the male or female seat, and lists 'No Petition Filed' placeholders after any filed candidates, so the Committeeman/Committeewoman labels here are positional, not gender assignments. Rules used: no filed candidate and zero write-in votes = both seats empty; no filed candidate but write-in votes = both unknown (write-ins only); one filed candidate = that seat filled if the candidate's votes exceed all write-ins combined, the other seat empty if there were zero write-ins, else unknown; two filed candidates = each counted as filling one seat if their votes exceed all write-ins combined (assumes they filed for different seats, the normal case); three or four filed candidates (28 contested districts) = only the top vote-getter is counted as filled, and the second seat is unknown because the winner of the other seat depends on candidates' genders, which the report does not give. Ties are unknown (the county notes ties create vacancies). The 2026 committee reports are not linked from the county's results page (whose 2026 link still points to the 2024 file); the official version was found at the county's upload path as the 8th revision. Post-election appointments are not reflected.
